source.quote: We use max reasoning effort for Muse Spark 1.3, Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, and xhigh for Muse Spark 1.2.

findings.text: Capability scoring treats model refusals as zero credit kept in the denominator rather than dropped.

source.quote: Model refusals receive zero credit and remain in the denominator rather than being dropped.

findings.text: Third-party comparison runs are best-effort and may not match provider-optimized settings.

source.quote: Our runs use common settings where practical but are best-effort: prompts, tools, and runtime may not be tuned for proprietary models and may not reflect their best provider-optimized performance.

notes: 4-page Meta Muse Spark 1.3 evaluation methodology PDF (text layer + page-4 raster results table). No safety, alignment, honesty, refusal, jailbreak, bias, or dangerous-capability section or numbers. Page 4 table is capability-only (GDPVal-AA v2, JobBench, OSWorld 2.0, DeepSearchQA, Agentic IF Index, AutomationBench, MRCR bands, DeepSWE v1.1, SWEAtlas CodeBase QnA, Terminal-Bench 2.1); skipped under pilot safety-only evalResults rule. Mentions of refusals are scoring rules for those capability benches, not a refusal/safety eval. Covers only Muse Spark 1.3 (report subject); Muse Spark 1.2 / Claude Opus 5 / GPT-5.6 Sol appear as comparisons only.
